newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Tadiran Telecom signs $6 mln in deals.
newsitem.headline: Tadiran Telecom signs $6 mln in deals.

text.p: Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd said on Sunday it had signed $6 million worth of agreements at Expocom Sviaz, a telecommunications trade show in Moscow.

A $2.7 million transaction was concluded with Uralsviazinform, one of Russia's largest government telecom companies, for the supply of multigain 2000 systems. These enable several subscribers to be connected simultaneously to a single copper pair in the existing basic infrastructure.
The Israeli company also signed agreements with the government telecom companies Udmurttelcom and Lipetskelectroviaz worth more than $3 million.

Tadiran Telecom, a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd, also announced the opening of a representative office in Moscow and its intention to establish in the near future an office in St. Petersburg. -Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211
